hook.text: Coding agents write faster than you can read. Mirador gives the agents you already use a canvas, so they can show you.

showPoint.text: Diagrams appear right beside your chat. Point at any part, and your agent redraws it live.

ask.text: When it's your call, skip numbered lists — pick from real previews with a click.

review.text: Reviews and tours walk you through changes in the order they run, and update in place when you push back.

sideChat.text: Select any text and ask about it in a side chat, while the main agent keeps working.

worktree.text: Give each conversation its own git worktree, then inspect, commit, and merge straight from Changes.

fork.text: Fork from any turn to branch off and try another way.

delegate.text: Mirador runs Claude Code, opencode, pi, Codex, Copilot, and Antigravity — and lets them hand work to each other.

jobs.text: Long build on another server? Mirador watches the job and wakes your agent when it's green.

media.text: Official plugins add apps like Media: mark what drags on the frame, and your agent cuts and renders the video.

p2p.text: Link Mirador on another computer peer to peer — encrypted end to end, with nothing to set up.

end.text: See what your coding agent means.
